subject.title: fix(msteams): read file attachments on Teams channel messages (team GUID + channel fallback + thread-reply URL)

question: Should Microsoft Teams channel/group messages with a text/html stub but no extracted <attachment id> marker start best-effort Graph media lookup by default when direct media download found nothing?
rationale: The code path fixes a real channel attachment loss bug, but it intentionally broadens Graph lookup attempts for Teams text/html stubs; automation cannot decide the acceptable default network/message-delivery tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Accept the narrowed fallback
options.body: Merge this PR or a rebased equivalent once exact-head checks are green, accepting that non-personal Teams text/html stubs can start Graph media lookup to recover channel files.

options.title: Require an opt-in or stricter signal
options.body: Ask the contributor to add an owner-approved gate, runtime signal, or config-backed opt-in before channel/group stubs can trigger Graph lookup without HTML attachment IDs.

options.title: Pause for more tenant variants
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers get fresh exact-head live proof for private/shared-channel or permission-denied variants before accepting the fallback default.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrowed fallback
recommendation.body: Merge this PR or a rebased equivalent once exact-head checks are green, accepting that non-personal Teams text/html stubs can start Graph media lookup to recover channel files.
